title: rfft~

messages.description: time domain real signal to transform
real part of frequency domain signal
imaginary part of frequency domain signal

body:
[rfft~] does a forward Fourier analysis of a real signal. It outputs N/2+1 real parts and N/2-1 imaginary parts, and the other outputs are zero: at DC and at the Nyquist frequency there is no imaginary part.

The analysis size is one block, which you can set with [block~] or [switch~]. There is no normalization, so an FFT followed by an IFFT has a gain of N.
